notes: The document does not publish a table of sample mortality rates (e.g., 'Sample Probability of Death' by age). Instead, it defines mortality assumptions as percentages of published base tables (RP-2014 Employee, RP-2014 Blue Collar Employee, RP-2014 Healthy Annuitant, RP-2014 Blue Collar Healthy Annuitant, RP-2014 Disabled Retiree) projected with the MP-2017 scale. Specifically: Pre-retirement Municipal/Elected is 110% (M)/115% (F) of RP-2014 Employee; Pre-retirement Uniformed is 85% of RP-2014 Blue Collar Employee. Post-retirement Municipal/Elected is 127% (M)/119% (F) of RP-2014 Healthy Annuitant; Post-retirement Uniformed is 115% of RP-2014 Blue Collar Healthy Annuitant. Post-disability Municipal/Elected is 95% of RP-2014 Disabled Retiree; Post-disability Uniformed is 80% of RP-2014 Disabled Retiree. Since the specific rate values by age are not printed, the target grid cannot be constructed from the document text alone.
